subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this older macOS onboarding PR be closed as superseded by current-main onboarding, or should a maintainer sponsor a narrow rebase for any remaining useful pieces?
rationale: The PR has a protected maintainer label and overlaps merged product-direction changes, so automation cannot choose whether to retire the branch or preserve selected UX work.

options.title: Close or replace with a narrow follow-up
options.body: Treat the merged bundled-Gateway and Crestodian onboarding paths as canonical, then ask for any remaining copy/preflight work as a new focused PR against current main.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Require a rebase plus fixes for the credentialed probe, acknowledgement bypass, env/launchd auth gate, and real macOS proof before considering merge.

options.title: Accept the branch risk
options.body: A maintainer could intentionally carry the stale wizard direction, but they would own the security, auth, and upgrade regressions called out here.

recommendation.title: Close or replace with a narrow follow-up
recommendation.body: Treat the merged bundled-Gateway and Crestodian onboarding paths as canonical, then ask for any remaining copy/preflight work as a new focused PR against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main macOS onboarding and bundled Gateway work makes this the clearest owner for the rebase-or-close product call.
